name: BLOODED: tokens
text: Your Blooded tokens are a team resource. You gain one in each Ready step, the first time each turning point an enemy operative is incapacitated, and the first time each turning point a friendly operative is incapacitated within 6 inches of an enemy. The Blooded gambit hands unassigned tokens to friendly Blooded operatives, one each.

name: BLOODED: favour
text: A Blooded operative holding a token has Accurate 1 on its weapons. If it is also under the Gaze of the Gods, one normal success kept through that Accurate 1 is kept as a critical success instead.

name: Blood Offering
text: The first time in a sequence the Butcher strikes with a critical success while fighting or retaliating with this weapon, you gain one Blooded token.

name: Stalk
text: While the Flenser fights or retaliates with this weapon and any Light or Heavy terrain is within its control range, the weapon has Lethal 5+.

name: Shield
text: While the Trench Sweeper fights or retaliates with this weapon, each of its blocks cancels two unresolved successes instead of one.

name: Blooded Icon
text: Once per turning point, when a friendly token holder is incapacitated while the Chieftain is within 6 inches of it, the token returns to your unassigned tokens instead of being lost.

name: Lead With Strength
text: While the Chieftain holds a token or stands wholly within your opponent's territory, it counts as under the Gaze of the Gods.

name: Grenadier
text: May use frag and krak grenades of its own, without spending the team's grenade uses. Whenever it throws one (its own or the team's), that grenade's Hit is 1 better.

name: Explosive Demise
text: When incapacitated, before removal, you may roll two D6 (one D6 if in an enemy control range). On any 4+, every other operative visible to and within 2 inches, friend or foe, takes D3+2 damage rolled separately, or D6+2 if the diabolyk bomb was never used.

name: Unholy Sustenance
text: When the Butcher incapacitates the enemy operative of a sequence in which it is fighting or retaliating, it regains up to D3 lost wounds.

name: SIGNAL
text: SUPPORT. Pick another friendly Blooded operative (not an Ogryn) visible to and within 6 inches: its APL is +1 until the end of its next activation. Not in an enemy control range.

name: SACRILEGIOUS ACTUATION
text: You gain one unassigned Blooded token. Only while the Commsman holds a token, and not in an enemy control range.

name: Regular Dosage
text: Before the battle you may give one other friendly Blooded operative the Enraged or Fortified STIMM rule for the whole battle.

name: STIMMS
text: Pick a friendly Blooded operative in the Corpseman's control range (itself included) and give it a STIMM rule: Rejuvenated heals up to 2D3 now, Enraged gives its melee weapons Relentless for the battle, Fortified lets it shave 1 damage off any die dealing 3 or more on a D6 roll of 5+. Each rule once per operative per battle. Not in an enemy control range.

name: Gruelling Disciplinarian
text: Friendly Blooded operatives within 6 inches of the Enforcer ignore every stat change from being injured, and one activated within 6 inches keeps ignoring them until its activation ends.

name: ENFORCE
text: Pick another friendly Blooded operative visible to and within 3 inches: it performs one 1 AP action for free, moving no more than 2 inches. A Commsman cannot use Signal or Sacrilegious Actuation this way. Not in an enemy control range.

name: Wretched
text: The Flenser may Charge while it has a Conceal order. If it is incapacitated in a fight, it still lands one unresolved success on its enemy before it is removed.

name: Avalanche of Muscle
text: When the Ogryn ends its move in a Charge, you may deal D3 damage to one enemy operative in its control range.

name: Chem-enhanced
text: Every change to the Ogryn's APL is ignored, and enemy Shock and Stun weapon rules do not affect it.

name: Brute
text: While the Ogryn has a Conceal order, Light terrain does not stop your opponent choosing it as a valid target when it is visible. Its cover save is unchanged.

name: Slow-witted
text: Pick Up Marker and mission actions (except Operate Hatch) cost the Ogryn 1 more AP.

name: Camo Cloak
text: When shot and able to keep any cover save, the Sharpshooter keeps one more. Not cumulative with the improved cover of Vantage terrain.

name: A Name Whispered In Blood
text: In the first turning point, as a gambit, pick an enemy operative. For the rest of the battle the Sharpshooter shooting that enemy counts as a token holder under the Gaze.

name: Tough
text: While the Thug fights, retaliates or is shot, an attack die with Normal Dmg 3 or more deals 1 less to it. Crits are not reduced.

name: Shielding
text: Whenever the Trench Sweeper is activated you may use this: until its next activation its Move is 2 inches less, and when it is shot you may re-roll any of your defence dice.

name: Group Activation
text: When a Trooper is expended, your next activation must be another ready friendly Blooded Trooper, if you have one. After that one, play passes to your opponent.
